# Rakshak Apparels — Comprehensive Catalog & Brand Profile
URL: https://rakshakus.vercel.app
Store Route: https://rakshakus.vercel.app
Brand Name: Rakshak Apparels (Rakshak Studio)
Entity: Rakshak Apparel & Footwear Co.
Founded: 2024
Category: Independent Direct-to-Consumer Streetwear, Sportswear & Athletic Footwear

## Brand Mission & Story
Rakshak Apparels is an independent contemporary fashion and performance sports studio creating architectural streetwear staples and durable athletic footwear. The label combines heavy-gauge organic Aegean cotton jersey, dense loopback French terry fleece, and Italian-assembled sports running footwear with authentic Vibram Megagrip outsoles. Every drop is produced in limited micro-batches to prioritize textile integrity, athletic performance, and zero deadstock waste.

## Order Fulfillment, Shipping & Returns
- **Fulfillment**: Orders process within 24–48 business hours.
- **Logistics**: Complimentary insured worldwide delivery via DHL Express on all orders.
- **Return Policy**: 30-day worldwide returns on all unworn items in original packaging with tags intact.
